text:
sanjeev: Quick sync — final run-through for marketplace launch day (tomorrow). Need: call tree, asset owners (press/blog/landing), SI support rota, and confirmation of certs/legal embargo. Reply with yes + any blockers.
elaine: Partners update: AWS listing green. GCP listing needs billing contact update (waiting on Hubert). SI partners confirmed 24h standby. I'll DM Hubert.
tom: Press & blog: embargoed press release + long-form blog scheduled. Need final customer quote by 17:00 PT. @jess can you confirm legal signoff window?
jess: Legal: embargo looks ok, added a small disclosure for third-party integrations. Pushed PDF to the thread (see Confluence link). No redlines expected.
maya: Infra: pre-prod smoke tests passed. Health checks look stable. I'll run KV priming before deploy. Snippet: ```curl -sS https://health.redwood.ai/marketplace/ready | jq .status```
carlos: Ops: deploy plan up in Confluence -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/deploy-plan. Rollback window 30m, blue/green. DB migration freeze = yes (no migrations during cut). All infra on call.
samir: SI (Nexus): integration runs scheduled, our on-call rota posted in shared channel #si-nexus-support. Two engineers rotating 12h. We'll run smoke tests immediately after cut.
sanjeev: Call tree draft (op order):
```
1) Pager triggers -> carlos (ops lead)
2) carlos -> maya (infra)
3) maya -> samir (SI lead)
4) samir -> elaine (partner PM)
5) elaine -> tom (marketing)/jess (legal)
6) exec escalation: sanjeev
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment to prod at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. ID: dep-202381234. Will emit reminders: 1h and 10m prior.
tom: Marketing: landing page assets uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-marketing/marketplace/). Hero image v7 awaiting signoff from design. Social scheduling set for 09:05 UTC (post-go-live).
elaine: FYI hardware partner shipments bumped ~8h. Not blocking listing, but demo units delayed — SI demos should use cloud demo images instead. I'll update partner docs.
sanjeev: Any outstanding compliance/export/contract checks? jess?
jess: One export-control checkbox pending from hardware partner (EULA addendum). Not blocker for launch, but must be in release notes and partner contract. Elaine to confirm before EOD.
carlos: Ops readiness: dashboards up -> https://dash.redwood.ai/marketplace. PagerDuty rotations confirmed. We'll monitor error_rate, p95 latency, token cost spike.
tom: If there's any rollback we hold social and press until cleared. Slack update plan: go/no-go announcement in #marketing at T+5m.
maya: Reminder: run KV cache priming script 30m before deploy: ```python scripts/prime_kv.py --env=prod --targets=marketplace --concurrency=8``` I'll run and post results.
samir: SI smoke test (post-deploy): `./si_test.sh --env=prod --tenant=marketplace --check=integrations` — will report pass/fail in #si-nexus-support.
sanjeev: Plan: I'll mark GO at 18:00 PT if no objections. Please react with :thumbsup: or call out blockers here.
elaine: :thumbsup: will confirm hardware EULA update by 16:00 PT.
tom: :thumbsup: all good from marketing side.
maya: :thumbsup: infra ready.
jess: :+1: legal cleared (pending EULA).
carlos: :+1: ops ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1 hour until deploy notification (will post in thread).
